description: This file defines the SerializationService interface for serialization and deserialization of objects within the OpenMRS system, including methods to get serializers, serialize, and deserialize objects, along with relevant annotations and documentation.

classes.name: SerializationService
classes.description: Interface for managing serializers and serializing/deserializing objects within OpenMRS.

methods.name: getDefaultSerializer
methods.description: Returns the default serializer configured for the system.

methods.name: getSerializer
methods.description: Retrieves a serializer that matches the provided class.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes an object into a string using a specified serializer class.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a string into an object of a specified class using a given serializer class.

methods.name: getSerializers
methods.description: Returns a list of registered serializers.
